arxiv-2004-06035.title: Triangle Groups: Automorphic Forms and Nonlinear Differential Equations
arxiv-2004-06035.creator: Sujay K. ASHOK †, Dileep P. JATKAR ‡ and Madhusudhan RAMAN §
arxiv-2004-06035.description: Abstract We study the relations governing the ring of quasiautomorphic forms associated to triangle groups with a single cusp, thereby extending our earlier results on Hecke groups. The Eisenstein series associated to these triangle groups are shown to satisfy Ramanujan-like identities. These identities in turn allow us to associate a nonlinear differential equation to each triangle group.

arxiv-2109-03599.title: Phonon Stability of Quantum Droplets in dipolar Bose gases
arxiv-2109-03599.creator: Fan Zhang, Lan Yin
arxiv-2109-03599.description: Abstract Stabilized by quantum fluctuations, dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates can form self-bound liquid-like droplets. However in the Bogoliubov theory, there are imaginary phonon energies in the long-wavelength limit, implying dynamical instability of this system. A similar instability appears in the Bogoliubov theory of a binary quantum droplet, and is removed due to higher-order quantum fluctuations as shown recently gu2020phonon .

arxiv-2302-08551.title: Infinite Action Contextual Bandits with Reusable Data Exhaust
arxiv-2302-08551.creator: Mark Rucker, Yinglun Zhu, Paul Mineiro
arxiv-2302-08551.description: Abstract For infinite action contextual bandits, smoothed regret and reduction to regression results in state-of-the-art online performance with computational cost independent of the action set: unfortunately, the resulting data exhaust does not have well-defined importance-weights. This frustrates the execution of downstream data science processes such as offline model selection.

arxiv-2303-07469.title: A Framework for Combining Entity Resolution and Query Answering in Knowledge Bases
arxiv-2303-07469.creator: Ronald Fagin, Phokion G. Kolaitis, Domenico Lembo, Lucian Popa, Federico Scafoglieri
arxiv-2303-07469.description: Abstract We propose a new framework for combining entity resolution and query answering in knowledge bases (KBs) with tuple-generating dependencies (tgds) and equality-generating dependencies (egds) as rules. We define the semantics of the KB in terms of special instances that involve equivalence classes of entities and sets of values.

arxiv-2304-11155.title: Commutation relations and stability of switched systems: a personal history
arxiv-2304-11155.creator: Daniel Liberzon
arxiv-2304-11155.description: Abstract This expository article presents an overview of research, conducted mostly between the mid-1990s and late 2000s, that explores a link between commutation relations among a family of asymptotically stable vector fields and stability properties of the switched system that these vector fields generate.

arxiv-2305-03588.title: X-ray Magnetic Circular Dichroism in Altermagnetic α \alpha -MnTe
arxiv-2305-03588.creator: A. Hariki, A. Dal Din, O. J. Amin, T. Yamaguchi, A. Badura, D. Kriegner, K. W. Edmonds, R. P. Campion, P. Wadley, D. Backes, L. S. I. Veiga, S. S. Dhesi, G. Springholz, L. Šmejkal, K. Výborný, T. Jungwirth, J. Kuneš
arxiv-2305-03588.description: Abstract Altermagnetism is a recently identified magnetic symmetry class combining characteristics of conventional collinear ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, that were regarded as mutually exclusive, and enabling phenomena and functionalities unparalleled in either of the two traditional elementary magnetic classes. In this work we use symmetry, ab initio theory and experiments to explore X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) in the altermagnetic class.

arxiv-2311-14693.title: Benefits and Harms of Large Language Models in Digital Mental Health
arxiv-2311-14693.creator: Munmun De Choudhury, Sachin R. Pendse, Neha KumarSchool of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA, USA{munmund, sachin.r.pendse, neha.kumar}@gatech.edu
arxiv-2311-14693.description: Abstract The past decade has been transformative for mental health research and practice. The ability to harness large repositories of data, whether from electronic health records (EHR), mobile devices, or social media, has revealed a potential for valuable insights into patient experiences, promising early, proactive interventions, as well as personalized treatment plans.

arxiv-2404-09229.title: A stable splitting for spaces of commuting elements in unitary groups
arxiv-2404-09229.creator: Alejandro Adem, José Manuel Gómez, Simon Gritschacher
arxiv-2404-09229.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alejandro Adem, José Manuel Gómez, Simon Gritschacher. We prove an analogue of Miller’s stable splitting of the unitary group U ⁡ ( m ) U(m) for spaces of commuting elements in U ⁡ ( m ) U(m) . , the space Hom ⁡ ( ℤ n , U ⁡ ( m ) ) \operatorname{Hom}(\mathbb{Z}^{n},U(m)) splits stably as a wedge of Thom-like spaces of bundles of commuting varieties over certain partial flag manifolds. Using Steenrod operations we prove that our splitting does not hold integrally.

arxiv-2409-14402.title: Bardeen-Dirac Stars in AdS Spacetime
arxiv-2409-14402.creator: Xiao-Yu Zhang, Li Zhao, Yong-Qiang Wang
arxiv-2409-14402.description: Abstract In this paper, we construct a static spherical symmetric Bardeen-Dirac Stars (BDSs) in the four-dimensional Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime, which consists of the electromagnetic field and Dirac field coupled to gravity. We investigate the ADM mass, Noether charge and light rings of BDSs in AdS spacetime. In asymptotically Minkowski spacetime, the maximum frequency of BDSs is one.

arxiv-2511-21817.title: A Paradigm Shift in Exoplanet False Positive Identification with HIP-44302
arxiv-2511-21817.creator: Arielle C. Frommer, Jason D. Eastman, David R. Ciardi, Steve B. Howell, George Zhou, Allyson Bieryla, Carl Ziegler, Kepler Owen
arxiv-2511-21817.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arielle C. Frommer, Jason D. Eastman, David R. Ciardi, Steve B. Howell, George Zhou, Allyson Bieryla, Carl Ziegler, Kepler Owen. Through detailed modeling of all three stars, we show that HIP-44302 is a false positive triple-star system.

arxiv-2512-23474.title: Deep classifier kriging for probabilistic spatial prediction of air quality index
arxiv-2512-23474.creator: Junyu Chen, Pratik Nag ∗, Huixia Judy-Wang, Ying Sun
arxiv-2512-23474.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Junyu Chen, Pratik Nag ∗, Huixia Judy-Wang, Ying Sun. Abstract

Accurate spatial interpolation of the air quality index (AQI), computed from concentrations of multiple air pollutants, is essential for regulatory decision-making, yet AQI fields are inherently non-Gaussian and often exhibit complex nonlinear spatial structure. Classical spatial prediction methods such as kriging are linear and rely on Gaussian assumptions, which limits their ability to capture these features and to provide reliable predictive distributions.

pmc-10675448.title: Domain-Specific Processing Stage for Estimating Single-Trail Evoked Potential Improves CNN Performance in Detecting Error Potential
pmc-10675448.creator: Andrea Farabbi, Luca Mainardi, Yifan Zhao
pmc-10675448.description: We present a novel architecture designed to enhance the detection of Error Potential (ErrP) signals during ErrP stimulation tasks. In the context of predicting ErrP presence, conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) typically accept a raw EEG signal as input, encompassing both the information associated with the evoked potential and the background activity, which can potentially diminish predictive accuracy.

pmc-11416004.title: Effectiveness of selective antibiotics use in ESBL-related UTIs
pmc-11416004.creator: Aththanayaka Mudiyanselage Waththe Gedara Kasun Prabuddha Aththanayaka, Gangulwitiya Gamage Yasodha Hansani Weerasinghe, Nimsha Sevwandika Weerakkody, Samarasinghe Herathge Gayani Geethika Samarasinghe, Upul Priyadharshana
pmc-11416004.description: BackgroundUrinary tract infections (UTIs) are the second most common infection, affecting 150 million people each year worldwide. Enterobacteriaceae species expressing extended-spectrum β-lactamases (ESBLs) are on the rise across the globe and are becoming a severe problem in the therapeutic management of clinical cases of urinary tract infection.

pmc-11433496.title: Use of Biomass Bottom Ash as an Alternative Solution to Natural Aggregates in Concrete Applications: A Review
pmc-11433496.creator: Florian Schlupp, Jonathan Page, Chafika Djelal, Laurent Libessart
pmc-11433496.description: Biomass bottom ash (BBA) is a by-product of the energy industry and is produced from biomass-fired thermal power plants. They represent the coarsest fraction of the recovered ash and are mostly landfilled. Several researchers have investigated the feasibility of the use of BBA as a replacement for natural aggregates in cementitious material.

pmc-11620119.title: New application of ombuoside in protecting auditory cells from cisplatin-induced ototoxicity via the apoptosis pathway
pmc-11620119.creator: Xingxing Wu, Xixia Peng, Yue Zhang, Wanjun Peng, Xiaochan Lu, Tingting Deng, Guohui Nie
pmc-11620119.description: Hearing loss is caused by many factors including ototoxic drug-induced hair cell damage. Ombuoside, an antioxidant isolated from Gynostemma pentaphyllum, has been suggested to serve as a new neuroprotective drug. However, the role of ombuoside in protecting inner ear hair cells from ototoxic drug-induced damage has not been investigated.

pmc-11697764.title: Relatively high interest but limited active engagement in HIV cure research: Awareness, interest, and information-seeking among affected communities in the Netherlands
pmc-11697764.creator: Maaike AJ Noorman, John BF de Wit, Tamika A Marcos, Sarah E Stutterheim, Thijs Albers, Kai J Jonas, Chantal den Daas
pmc-11697764.description: BackgroundCommunity engagement is important for inclusive HIV cure development. This study evaluates current engagement in HIV cure research among affected communities in the Netherlands by analyzing awareness, interest, and information-seeking behavior. It also identifies participant characteristics and HIV-related illness perceptions linked to each engagement stage.

pmc-11712702.title: Exploring Semantic Topics in Dementia Caregiver Tweets
pmc-11712702.creator: Yanbo Feng, Bojian Hou, Ari Klein, Karen O'Connor, Jiong Chen, Andrés Mondragón, Shu Yang, Graciela Gonzalez‐Hernandez, Li Shen
pmc-11712702.description: BackgroundCaring for family caregivers of dementia patients has grown to an important topic. Social media platforms, like Twitter, provide great resources for studying the needs of caregivers. It would be beneficial to understand the caregivers’ interested or concerned topics from their tweets. Meanwhile, topic modeling has become an efficient NLP tool for analyzing semantic themes within texts.

pmc-12418575.title: Shprintzen-Goldberg syndrome: follow-up of the cardiovascular features in an international cohort of 29 patients with SGS
pmc-12418575.creator: Yordi-Michaël Bouhatous, Pauline Arnaud, Guillaume Jondeau, Dominique Bonneau, Frédéric Rouleau, Ghislaine Plessis, Aline Vincent, Fabien Labombarda, Pascale Maragnes, Julian Delanne, Matthias Muller, Christine Coubes, Charlene Bredy, Laurent Gouya, Sylvie Odent, Adeline Basquin, Sophie Dupuis-Girod
pmc-12418575.description: BackgroundShprintzen-Goldberg syndrome (SGS) shares skeletal features with Marfan syndrome (MFS), but differs in its craniofacial and neurodevelopmental features. Cardiovascular features have been specifically investigated in few of the 57 known patients with SGS described in the literature, making it difficult to determine their prevalence and characteristics.

In this paper, the achieved state-of-the-art understanding regarding the wear behaviour of various PVD (physical vapour deposition) coatings deposited on TiB2/Ti composites produced by SPS (spark plasma sintering) is presented. The objective of this paper is to investigate the wear behaviour of various PVD coatings deposited on TiB2/Ti composites manufactured by SPS, when lubricated with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as an external solid lubricant in the range from room temperature up to 900 °C in friction contacts under extreme pressure and with

pmc-12770631.title: MiRNA expression analysis from circulating exosomes in Barrett’s esophagus patients with visceral obesity
pmc-12770631.creator: Mimi Liu, Jing Lv, Yan Cheng, Jun Wang, Dong Liu, Fenrong Chen
pmc-12770631.description: Visceral obesity is a recognized risk factor for Barrett’s esophagus (BE). Circulating exosomal mirnas have been identified as potential biomarkers of BE. The aim of this study was to elucidate the characteristics of plasma exosomal miRNA expression in BE patients with or without visceral obesity and to explore its potential regulatory mechanisms in the pathogenesis of the disease.

pmc-13137624.title: Posterior insular cortex hyperactivation drives vestibular migraine and comorbid anxiety
pmc-13137624.creator: Tianyu Zhang, Yifei Xiang, Bin Huang, Xiaoping Wang, Ping Yang, Baoming He, Nengwei Yu, Jie Liu
pmc-13137624.description: BackgroundVestibular migraine, a debilitating disorder characterized by recurrent episodes of headache and vertigo, is frequently comorbid with persistent anxiety and depression. The neural mechanisms that integrate these disparate sensory and affective symptoms remain elusive.FindingsHere, we combined clinical characterization with a translational mouse model to identify the posterior insular cortex (pIC) as a critical hub driving the pathophysiology of vestibular migraine.

pmc-13387034.title: Synergizing Covalent‐Ionic Tri‐Site Coordination in P2‐type Na0.67Fe0.33Mn0.67O2 Induces Suppressed Layer‐Slipping and Stablized Lattice Oxygen for Sodium‐Ion Batteries at Wide Potential
pmc-13387034.creator: Haitao Xue, Xudong Shi, Zhiyue Lian, Wenxiu He, Genqiang Zhang, Yongqiang Zhang
pmc-13387034.description: Improving the stability of the oxygen framework and suppressing irreversible interlayer slip remain long‐standing challenges for Fe/Mn‐based layered oxide cathodes. Herein, a trans‐sublattice three‐site co‐substitution strategy is proposed and implemented in Na0.67Fe0.08Cu0.25Mn0.62Mg0.05O1.95F0.05 (NFCMMOF) to precisely regulate the covalent‐ionic bonding balance within both cationic and anionic sublattices.

pmc-13400517.creator: Pushpa Narayanaswami, Jamie Sullivan, Craig Thiele, Christina Ramirez, Susan dosReis, Allison Foss, Karen S Yee, Mayvis Rebeira, Naila Wahid, Alexis C Garduno, Elizabeth Crevier, Christine Rowe, Kelly G Gwathmey

pmc-13587436.title: Predicting abnormal birth weight and identifying associated factors using machine learning in the Hararghe Health and Demographic Surveillance System, Ethiopia
pmc-13587436.creator: Sington Abdeta, Ousmane Diop, Steve Cygu, Aboubacry Drame, Reinpeter Momanyi, Belayneh Endalamaw Dejene, Mulugeta Tadele, Yordanos Sintayehu, Miranda Barasa, Mirkuzie Woldie, Tsinuel Girma, Rosa Tsegaye, Agnes Kiragga, Bethlehem Adnew, Rawleigh Howe, Merga Dheresa, Alemseged Abdisa
pmc-13587436.description: BackgroundBirth weight is a reliable indicator of intrauterine growth and an important predictor of neonatal survival, growth, and long-term development. Globally, approximately 15.5% of live births are low birth weight, and nearly 10% are macrosomic (high birth weight), with a substantial proportion of these cases occurring in sub-Saharan Africa.

pmc-13610011.title: Pre-Analytical Stability of Mycophenolic Acid and Its Glucuronide in Saliva Samples Stored in Cotton Salivette® Devices Before Centrifugation
pmc-13610011.creator: Grzegorz Szynkaruk, Julia Kerner, Ahata Nelipovich, Kacper Osuch, Maria Miotk, Agata Bartkowiak, Joanna Sobiak
pmc-13610011.description: Background/Objectives: Saliva may provide a non-invasive alternative to blood sampling for therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) of mycophenolic acid (MPA) in children. This study assessed MPA and, secondarily, mycophenolic acid glucuronide (MPAG) in non-centrifuged Salivette® devices to determine an acceptable interval between saliva collection and laboratory processing.

pmc-13633346.title: A dual-electropolymerized poly(Xylenol orange)@poly(Euchrysine) sensing interface for sustainable simultaneous electroanalysis of 5-fluorouracil and empagliflozin: density functional theory mechanistic elucidation
pmc-13633346.creator: Rania S. Ibrahim, Hanaa M. Abd El-Wadood, Marwa R. El-Zahry, Antonio Frontera, Noha M. Hosny
pmc-13633346.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A sensitive and sustainable electroanalytical approach for the simultaneous determination of 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) and empagliflozin (EMPA) is desirable for pharmaceutical and bioanalytical investigations, particularly in preliminary studies exploring their concomitant use and potential protective effects. Herein, a square-wave voltammetric (SWV) method was developed using a sequentially fabricated poly-XO@poly-EUC/PGE sensing interface, prepared by successive electropolymerization of euchrysine (EUC) and xylenol orange (XO) on the surface of pencil graphite electrode (PGE). Electrochemical and morphological characterization confirmed successful electrode modification and improved interfacial electron-transfer properties.
